# x65flasher

**Homepage:** [http://chaos.allsiemens.com/software.html](https://web.archive.org/web/20130813164842/http://chaos.allsiemens.com/software.html) (web archive)<br/>
**Author:** Chaos<br/>
**Platforms:** x65/x75 (SGOLD)

<div className="screenshot">

![x65flasher: screenshot 1](./x65flasher/img/x65flasher.png)

</div>

A flasher for 65–75 series phones plus a midlet for finding boot keys.

- Reading and writing the phone's flash memory
- Backing up and restoring both the entire fullflash and individual parts
  (file system, firmware, EEPROM)
- Viewing the flash memory map
- Operating at speeds from 57600 to 1600000 bit/s
- Generating loaders for V_Klay
